episodes.name: WHIH Newsfront Promo
episodes.overviewEn: The first video is a promotion video and announces the video for next week. Christine Everhart talks about next week's news, where they are going to discuss the Avengers at the Battle of Sokovia and the release of former criminal Scott Lang.

episodes.name: WHIH Newsfront Top Stories
episodes.overviewEn: The second video was aired on July 7. WHIH reports that since the events at Sokovia, the issue for more goverment control and transparancy for superheroes continues to be a important topic. The rest of the video reminds the viewers of the incident in 2012 where Scott Lang broke in at Vistacorp Headquarters and stole millions of dollars. More background information is given in the Mashable article: 'Everyday hero or thief? Cyber criminal to address 2012 arrest.'

episodes.name: WHIH EXCLUSIVE: 2012 VistaCorp break-in security footage involving cyber-criminal Scott Lang
episodes.overviewEn: On July 10, 2015 WHIH News claimed to have obtained footage of the 2012 break-in at VistaCorp involving cyber-criminal Scott Lang. The next day they released the footage as a WHIH Exclusive.

episodes.name: WIRED Insider Interviews Darren Cross, CEO of Pym Technologies
episodes.overviewEn: Darren Cross speaks with WIRED Insider about the future of Pym Technologies.

episodes.name: WHIH Exclusive: Scott Lang Interview
episodes.overviewEn: Christine Everhart takes an interview of Scott Lang via satellite to his prison. More background information is given in the Mashable article: 'Confessions of a whistle blower.'

episodes.name: AVENGERS IMPACT: A WHIH Newsfront Special Report
episodes.overviewEn: The Avengers have saved our world… but at what cost? WHIH Newsfront returns with a special report. Join Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams as they investigate “The World the Hero Leaves Behind.”

episodes.name: WHIH Newsfront: The Cost of Saving The World
episodes.overviewEn: Join Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams as they ask viewers who should be responsible for all of the cost associated with the clean up and rebuilding process. WHIH Newsfront: Who Should Pay for Avengers Damage?

episodes.name: WHIH Newsfront: The Avengers and The White House
episodes.overviewEn: Join WHIH Newsfront as host Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams debate the Avengers and the role that the White House and President Ellis should play.

episodes.name: WHIH Newsfront Exclusive: President Ellis Discusses the Avengers
episodes.overviewEn: WHIH Newsfront lands an exclusive interview with President Ellis. Join as Christine Everhart and political correspondent Will Adams ask him about nominating Thaddeus Ross as Secretary of State plus his thoughts on regulating the Avengers.

episodes.name: WHIH Breaking News: Attack In Lagos
episodes.overviewEn: WHIH Newsfront goes live with breaking news of an attack in Lagos, Nigeria. Reports of Avengers on the scene are among other details explored by Christine Everhart, political correspondent Will Adams, and field reporter Jackson Norris.
